description: The command hooks of the harness, a person's file under harness.self, beside the function-hook module `modules` names. PreToolUse is xtask permit over the hook's stdin (harness-design.md §4.4), in two entries that differ only in what they do when no candidate judges; the hook's stdin is buffered and the candidates walked, each built binary and then cargo, stopping at the first that exits 0: permit's exit is 0 whatever it decides, so a non-zero one is a build that never judged, one older than the manifest it reads, compiled against another one, or handed a flag it does not know, and the call is never passed on that build's silence. On Edit and Write, a list that ends with no candidate judging is a deny with that reason: a write no judge saw does not proceed (#16 item 2). On Bash it is handed on, since an agent repairs a broken harness with Bash, and denying all three deadlocks the repair; what an unjudged Bash can still write is #16 item 5, and pre-commit is its twin. A built binary is a process start; cargo closes the list, rebuilding rather than trusting a stale one, about 200 ms more, and the timeout leaves room for that rebuild. PostToolUse on Bash is xtask permit --after over the same stdin (#1516, #1517), and so is PostToolUseFailure on Bash, the event a call that exits non-zero gets in place of PostToolUse, so such a call is settled and sensed too (#2762): it puts back and denies a harness.self file the call moved, against the blobs permit recorded before it, in the same walk of candidates. Stop is xtask done --hook over the hook's stdin (§4.5): the turn is held with the unmet list as the reason, and the second Stop, stop_hook_active true, passes; it walks the built binaries and then cargo, as PreToolUse does, since `done --hook` exits 1 from a build apart from the tree (#2982), so a turn that changed xtask itself is judged by the rebuild, and a cargo that fails is a block naming the build, never a silent pass, except on the second Stop. SessionStart on startup, resume, clear and compact points core.hooksPath at scripts/hooks when the clone has none, so pre-push is wired, lays the local file down when missing and renders it; the map plus the local facts reach the model through the function hook's prompt.context (harness-plugins/, enabled by .claude/settings.json as harness@dax-php from the repository's own marketplace; §5), and a session without the plugin has no map. Once a session, so it goes through cargo run, which rebuilds a stale binary rather than trusting it.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && printf '%s' "$in" | "$x" permit 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit || printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"xtask permit did not judge this call: every candidate refused or failed to run. An Edit or a Write no judge saw does not proceed; a Bash call still does, so the harness can be repaired. Rebuild it: cargo build -p xtask."}}'; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && printf '%s' "$in" | "$x" permit 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && printf '%s' "$in" | "$x" permit --after 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit --after; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && printf '%s' "$in" | "$x" permit --after 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- permit --after; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && in=$(cat) && { for x in target/release/xtask target/debug/xtask; do [ -x "$x" ] && printf '%s' "$in" | "$x" done --hook 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; printf '%s' "$in" | cargo run -q -p xtask -- done --hook || case $in in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*) ;; *) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"xtask done did not run: cargo run -q -p xtask -- done --hook failed; fix the build of xtask"}';; esac; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -n "$(git config core.hooksPath)" ] || git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks; X='cargo run -q -p xtask --'; [ -f .claude/harness.local.md ] || $X status --session >/dev/null; computed run .claude/harness.local.md >/dev/null 2>&1; case $? in 0|1) ;; 2) echo 'harness: a marker in .claude/harness.local.md is broken; see `computed check .claude/harness.local.md`';; *) echo 'harness: computed did not run; the local facts are stale (cargo install computed)';; esac
